deep_dive.title: Nonparametric Schrödinger Bridge Time Series Generator: Algorithm, Convergence Analysis and Applications
deep_dive.abstract: We conduct a convergence analysis for the Schrödinger Bridge Time Series (SBTS) data generator. Starting from a regularized formulation in which the data ensemble is mixed with a standard multivariate Gaussian distribution with a prescribed probability, we prove that the Euler-Maruyama discretization converges to the mixed target distribution with half-order convergence rate, provided that the ensemble size and kernel bandwidth are chosen appropriately. We further show that the regularized distribution converges to the original target distribution as the mixing probability tends to zero. The analysis simultaneously accounts for the ensemble approximation error, kernel approximation error, and time-discretization error, and therefore provides a full distributional convergence result for the SBTS generator. Empirically, we further examine the flexibility of the method by replacing the Wiener reference measure with the path measure induced by a more general SDE. The numerical experiments show that the schemes based on both the original Wiener reference measure and the SDE-induced reference measure achieve comparable performance, demonstrating the robustness and stability of the SBTS framework.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Presents a nonparametric Schrodinger Bridge Time Series (SBTS) generator mixing data with Gaussian and proving half-order Euler-Maruyama convergence to the mixed target, with regularization to the original distribution as mixing probability tends to zero.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 本文针对时间序列生成问题，提出一种非参数薛定谔桥生成器（SBTS）。该生成器将数据样本与标准高斯分布混合，并利用Euler-Maruyama离散化求解薛定谔桥问题。作者证明了离散化以半阶收敛速率收敛到混合目标分布，且当混合概率趋于零时，正则化分布收敛到原始数据分布。实验结果表明该方法能有效生成时间序列，并给出了集成精度、核近似与时间离散误差的统一分析。
